summary.work_completed: Authored 13 test IDs (T-88-01 through T-88-13) covering all acceptance criteria from Issue #88. Tests are contract-first: they define the interface the coding agent must implement.
key_findings: Toolbar buttons must call historyStore.undo/redo and sceneStore.clearScene/export on click
useKeyboardShortcuts must register window keydown listener and handle R, Delete, Escape, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y
useBrickPlacement must return onPointerDown/onPointerMove/onPointerUp handlers and wire them to the canvas
All stores must expose the required action functions (setActiveBrickType, setActiveBrickColor, clearScene, undo, redo, clearSelection, removeBrick)

recommended_actions: Read docs/bugs/FR-88/LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN.md for the complete fix specification
Wire BrickPalette.tsx onClick handlers to sceneStore.setActiveBrickType and setActiveBrickColor
Wire Toolbar.tsx onClick handlers to historyStore.undo/redo, sceneStore.clearScene, and export function
Mount useKeyboardShortcuts in App.tsx or Viewport.tsx and implement all key handlers
Wire useBrickPlacement hook to Viewport.tsx canvas pointer events
Ensure useKeyboardShortcuts is called in App.tsx component body
Check for CSS pointer-events:none or z-index overlay blocking interactions
Run: cd frontend && npm test -- --run to verify all unit/component tests pass
